message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).

| Time zone | UTC offset | Typical local time when it’s 12:00 PM in Los Angeles |
|-----------|------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| Los Angeles (PST/PDT) | UTC‑8 / UTC‑7 | 12:00 PM |
| Berlin (CET/CEST) | UTC+1 / UTC+2 | 9:00 PM |

Because both regions observe daylight‑saving time at the same time of year, the 9‑hour gap stays constant throughout the year. So, if it’s 3 PM in Los Angeles, it’s 12 AM the next day in Berlin.
